notes: No registration is required for this follow-up notice. Expiry is 12 months after the verified camp closing date, 2026-08-30. Approved Vietnamese full text can be added by editors.
title: The Emmaus journey continues
summary: The post-camp assignment is now available. Continue your formation through prayer, spiritual reading, and service in your chapter.
description:
The Training Committee has released the Emmaus II post-camp assignment for candidate youth leaders. Participants have 12 months from the last day of camp to complete the requirements and submit verification.

Read the assignment for the full instructions, and contact the Training Committee with questions.
